proposed_ledger_entry: Item 329 replaces the Item-326 bounded-gap viewpoint by a genuinely single-row theorem for the factor actually selected by the ordinary fixed-j1 collision. On every actual fixed-M row M=3h+4s+2, p=4h+6s+3, it proves c_plus=(4M+1)2^(1-4M)K_(M,2h) mod p with K_(M,n)=[t^n](2-4t+3t^2-t^3)^(4M), and audits every prefactor as a p-unit. Hence every original ordinary collision forces p|K_(M,6M-4p). It also constructs J_(M,2s+5), L_(M,p)=4J+3(4M+1)K, proves c_minus=-2^(1-4M)L/3 mod p, and therefore proves the exact full-container union p|D iff p|K or p|L. The K-array is one fixed rational Cartier object with generating function 1/(1-zP(t)^4), Laurent Cartier readout [z^M u^4]Lambda_p Phi, and an exact four-term coefficient recurrence. A comparison family proves that a shared degree-O(M) integer carrier, strict alternating signs, and exp(O(M)) l1 height alone imply no strict capacity reduction. The cubic/Cartier/recurrence-specific weighted zero-density problem remains open. Five preselected rows are replay controls only, no prime scan or new full-collision claim is made, booking is zero, and the fixed-j1 ceiling remains 1/36 per 6M.
